IntMap is free because people support it.

There is no advertising and no paid plan. Giving unlocks nothing: everyone gets the same map, whether they give or not.

Donate in US dollarsDonate in yen

What running IntMap costs

Only what is real is listed. Where IntMap records a figure, it is shown; where it records none, no figure is given.

Atlas, the AI assistant

Every question sent to Atlas is a paid request to an AI provider. That is why each account has 10 questions a day.

The server and the database

Accounts, saved items, the news pipeline and the relays run on IntMap's Supabase project.

The base map

The base map tiles come from CARTO, within its free allowance of 5,000,000 tile requests a month.

Time

IntMap is built and checked by its maintainer. Donations let that time go to the map.
